Not necessarily. Hansen records **tree-cover loss during 2020**, while JRC provides a **forest/non-forest reference map for 2020**. They measure different things at different resolutions, so the figures are not directly comparable. The evidence does not establish why they differ at this property.

The 67.7 ha Hansen loss is before the 31 December 2020 baseline and outside the assessed 2021–2025 period. For that later period, no loss event of at least 0.5 ha was detected; Hansen did record 0.4 ha in smaller patches in 2021.
